title: MQTT Command Desk
summary: Separate commands, acknowledgements and errors in a bidirectional MQTT device.

briefing.text: Separate commands, acknowledgements and errors in a bidirectional MQTT device.
The parts are placed but unwired. Complete the wiring and sketch, then follow the experiments in Learn to earn each objective.

learn.title: MQTT Command Desk
learn.body:
Wire GPIO18 → 220 Ω → LED → GND. Join virtual VoltNet with password pass and use broker.voltquest.local:1883. Subscribe to bench/lamp/set and service mqtt.loop().

Accept the exact payload ON or OFF. Apply the LED state before publishing the same word to bench/lamp/state. For every other payload publish INVALID to bench/lamp/error and leave the LED unchanged. Build the command from exactly length bytes in the callback; an MQTT payload is not guaranteed to end with a zero byte.

In IoT, publish ON, then ON!, then OFF to bench/lamp/set, pausing between messages. Confirm the LED stays lit during INVALID, and that only valid commands produce state acknowledgements. Commands and state use separate topics so a device never mistakes its own report for a new command.
